class.name: CgameRTEffect
class.brief_description: Hardware ray-traced shadows and ambient occlusion as a native compositor effect.
class.description: [CgameRTEffect] is the render-thread half of a hardware ray-traced shadow and ambient occlusion pipeline. It owns all GPU state: one bottom-level acceleration structure (BLAS) per mesh surface with budgeted builds and least-recently-used eviction, one top-level acceleration structure (TLAS) rebuilt whenever a new instance snapshot arrives, and three compute passes. The shadow pass shoots one jittered ray per pixel towards the sun disc, the AO pass shoots cosine-weighted hemisphere rays of limited length (both using [code]GL_EXT_ray_query[/code] against the TLAS, reading the scene depth buffer and normals reconstructed from it), and the denoise pass applies a depth-aware spatial filter and a reprojected, neighbourhood-clamped temporal filter before compositing onto the opaque color buffer. The effect runs at [constant CompositorEffect.EFFECT_CALLBACK_TYPE_POST_OPAQUE], so transparent surfaces are drawn after it. The GLSL of all passes is embedded in the engine. [b]Fallback.[/b] The effect disables itself silently when the rendering device lacks [constant RenderingDevice.SUPPORTS_RAY_QUERY], a shader fails to compile or a resource cannot be created. [method has_failed] reports this; the raster path is never touched. It also does nothing on the Compatibility and Mobile renderers. [b]Driver.[/b] The effect does not scan the scene. A driver node picks the nearest meshes, extracts triangles within a per-update budget using [method extract_triangles], [method pack_positions] and [method pack_indices], and hands the snapshot over with [method submit]. When the effect evicts a BLAS it reports the key through [method take_evicted_keys] and the driver must re-submit that geometry. The static helpers in this class implement that driver-side logic. [codeblock] var effect := CgameRTEffect.new() effect.configure(CgameRTEffect.settings(3)) var compositor := Compositor.new() compositor.compositor_effects = [effect] camera.compositor = compositor # Every few frames: effect.submit(instances, new_geometry, sun_direction, sun_angular_radius) [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] Ray query is not available on Metal today, so on macOS this effect stays inactive.

method.name: blas_key
method.description: Returns the stable key of one mesh surface, shared by all instances of it.

method.name: budget_take
method.description: Returns how many of [param pending] expensive operations may run this frame: the smaller of both values, never negative.

method.name: builds_this_frame
method.description: Returns how many BLAS builds to start this frame for [param queued] waiting builds and a per-frame [param budget].

method.name: configure
method.description: Sets the effect configuration from a dictionary such as the one returned by [method settings]. Read keys: [code]shadows[/code], [code]ao[/code], [code]ao_rays[/code], [code]max_instances[/code], [code]blas_builds_per_frame[/code], [code]shadow_tmax[/code], [code]ao_tmax[/code], [code]shadow_strength[/code], [code]ao_strength[/code] and [code]temporal_blend[/code]. Safe to call from the main thread at any time.

method.name: eviction_candidates
method.description: Returns the BLAS keys to evict. [param last_used] maps keys to the frame they were last used. Keys are returned oldest first and only while [param count] exceeds [param limit]; only entries unused for at least [constant EVICT_AGE] frames at [param frame] qualify.

method.name: extract_triangles
method.description: Returns the triangle data of one surface as a dictionary with [code]ok[/code], [code]vertices[/code] ([PackedVector3Array]) and [code]indices[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]). Indices are generated as [code]0..n-1[/code] for non-indexed surfaces. [code]ok[/code] is [code]false[/code] for invalid surfaces, non-triangle primitives, fewer than three vertices, index counts that are not a multiple of three, and surfaces above [constant MAX_TRIANGLES_PER_SURFACE] triangles.

method.name: get_common_source
method.description: Returns the GLSL helper block shared by all passes (parameter block, hash, depth reconstruction, normals and ray query helper).

method.name: get_pass_source
method.description: Returns the embedded GLSL source of a pass: [code]"rt_shadows"[/code], [code]"rt_ao"[/code] or [code]"rt_denoise"[/code]. Returns an empty string for other names. The source contains an include line that [method prepare_source] replaces with [method get_common_source].

method.name: group_count
method.description: Returns the number of compute workgroups needed to cover [param pixels] with groups of [param group_size].

method.name: has_failed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once the effect has disabled itself because ray queries are unsupported or a resource failed.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the last frame was traced and composited.

method.name: is_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param rd] can build acceleration structures and run ray queries ([constant RenderingDevice.SUPPORTS_RAY_QUERY]).

method.name: pack_indices
method.description: Returns the 32-bit index stream for a BLAS index buffer.

method.name: pack_params
method.description: Returns the [constant PARAMS_SIZE] byte uniform block used by the passes: three 4x4 matrices (inverse projection, camera to world, previous view-projection), the sun direction and radius, the frame size, frame index and AO ray count, the ray lengths and bias, and the shadow strength, AO strength and temporal blend taken from [param config].

method.name: pack_positions
method.description: Returns a tightly packed R32G32B32 float position stream for a BLAS vertex buffer.

method.name: prepare_source
method.description: Returns [param pass_source] with the [code]#[lb]compute[rb][/code] header removed and the common include line replaced by [param common_source].

method.name: select_nearest
method.description: Returns the nearest [param max_count] candidates within [param max_distance] of [param origin]. Candidates are dictionaries with [code]position[/code] ([Vector3]) and [code]radius[/code] ([float]) plus any extra keys. They are ordered by surface distance (center distance minus radius, never below zero); ties keep input order.

method.name: settings
method.description: Returns the configuration for a quality level between [code]0[/code] (off) and [code]3[/code]. Only the [code]forward_plus[/code] renderer enables the effect. The dictionary holds [code]enabled[/code], [code]shadows[/code], [code]ao[/code] (level 2 and above), [code]ao_rays[/code], [code]max_distance[/code], [code]max_instances[/code], [code]blas_builds_per_frame[/code], [code]extractions_per_update[/code], [code]update_interval[/code], [code]shadow_tmax[/code], [code]ao_tmax[/code], [code]shadow_strength[/code], [code]ao_strength[/code] and [code]temporal_blend[/code].

method.name: shader_path
method.description: Returns the project-relative path [code]res://shaders/compute/<pass_name>.glsl[/code] used by the GDScript implementation of the same effect. The native effect reads the embedded sources instead and never loads this file.

method.name: submit
method.description: Hands a snapshot to the render thread. [param instances] is an array of dictionaries with [code]key[/code] (see [method blas_key]) and [code]transform[/code] ([Transform3D]). [param geometry] maps keys of meshes the render thread has not seen yet to dictionaries with [code]vertices[/code] and [code]indices[/code] ([PackedByteArray]), [code]vertex_count[/code] and [code]index_count[/code]. [param sun_dir] points towards the sun; [param sun_radius] is the sun's angular radius in radians.

method.name: take_evicted_keys
method.description: Returns and clears the BLAS keys the render thread dropped. The caller must submit their geometry again before they can be traced.

constants.constant: Size in bytes of the parameter uniform block.
Number of acceleration structures kept before eviction starts.
Frames without use before a BLAS may be evicted.
Surfaces with more triangles are skipped as too costly to extract and build.
